definitions.gloss: board surface; board position; state of the board
definitions.explanation: The surface of a game board (such as shogi, go, or chess), or the current arrangement of pieces on it.

examples.japanese: {盤面|ばんめん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{打|う}て→打つ：01221_utsu⟧。
examples.english: Look carefully at the board before making your move.

examples.japanese: {盤面|ばんめん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{複雑|ふくざつ}→複雑：01115_fukuzatsu⟧になってきた。
examples.english: The board position has become complicated.

examples.japanese: ⟦{解説者|かいせつしゃ}→解説者：09688_kaisetsusha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{盤面|ばんめん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一手|いって}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{予想|よそう}した→予想する：06064_yosousuru⟧。
examples.english: The commentator predicted the next move while looking at the board position.

notes:
Refers to both the physical surface of a game board and the current state of play on it. Most commonly used in the context of ⟦{将棋|しょうぎ}→将棋：04172_shougi⟧ (shogi), ⟦{囲碁|いご}→囲碁：18035_igo⟧ (go), and ⟦チェス→チェス：11040_chesu⟧ (chess). Also used in board game and video game contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {盤面|ばんめん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to look at the board
- {盤面|ばんめん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{動|うご}く→動く：00904_ugoku⟧: the board position changes
- {盤面|ばんめん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧: to read the board position
- {盤面|ばんめん}⟦{全体|ぜんたい}→全体：03314_zentai⟧: the entire board

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{局面|きょくめん}→局面：05777_kyokumen⟧: phase, situation — used in games and more broadly for situations
- ⟦{盤|ばん}→盤：18576_ban⟧: board — the physical board itself (⟦{将棋盤|しょうぎばん}→将棋盤：24835_shougiban⟧, ⟦{碁盤|ごばん}→碁盤：13716_goban⟧)
- ⟦{棋譜|きふ}→棋譜：23969_kifu⟧: game record — the written record of moves played
